description: This file defines an abstract class 'BatchWorker' that implements a pattern for asynchronous batch processing, managing work cycles, scheduling, and synchronization. It also includes a concrete implementation 'BatchWorkerFromDelegate' that executes a provided delegate as its work.

classes.name: BatchWorker
classes.description: An abstract class implementing a pattern for asynchronous batch processing with scheduling, notification, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: BatchWorkerFromDelegate
classes.description: A concrete subclass of BatchWorker that executes a delegate as its work implementation.

methods.name: Work
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, defining the work cycle.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Signals the worker that there is more work to process.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Schedules a notification at a specific UTC time to trigger work.

methods.name: ScheduleNotify
methods.description: Asynchronously delays until the specified time and then triggers a notification.

methods.name: CheckForMoreWork
methods.description: Checks if additional work has arrived and starts a new cycle if needed.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Returns true if the worker is currently idle.

methods.name: WaitForCurrentWorkToBeServiced
methods.description: Returns a task that completes when the current and possibly next work cycles are finished.

methods.name: CreateNextWorkCyclePromise
methods.description: Creates a promise for the next work cycle to wait on.

methods.name: NotifyAndWaitForWorkToBeServiced
methods.description: Signals more work and waits for current and next work cycles to complete.
